verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own docs say any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit filings through the same rail, and organisations can authenticate with ELSTER certificates obtained through a published free registration, so a sanctioned software-to-service channel exists. However, the pack never documents the developer/transmitter interface (ERiC appears only in a probe) or a published enrollment path for software vendors or system accounts. The probe's single timed-out request to the ERiC artifact host shows a reachability issue, not a contradiction of the channel. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the ERiC/transmitter interface, a published enrollment path for software providers or system accounts, batch-provider details, and independent corroboration.
